user.title: Connect CORE Family Hub
user.description: In CORE, open Settings > Integrations > Home Assistant and create a pairing code. Enter it here. Home Assistant makes only outbound connections; you do not need to expose your home to the internet.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect or the pairing code is invalid or expired.
error.invalid_auth: CORE rejected the connection. Create a new pairing code.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTPS CORE bridge URL.

abort.already_configured: This CORE connection is already configured.
